lines.l: When the dark comes down, and we can't see
Hold the horizon, hold it with me
We were never lost, just learning to bring it in
The city fell away like a paper map
Street by street into shadow and rain
I've kept your echo in the back of my chest
Soft as a wave that returns again
For the horizon
Hold it with me
When the dark comes down
And we can't see
Hold the horizon
Hold it with me
We were never lost
Just learning to breathe
Maybe healing is not a straight line
Maybe it starts through a broken sky
Maybe we fall just to learn the shape of how to rise and stay alive
So if the tide turns and the ground gives weight
I'll meet you there
At the edge of death
Hold the horizon
Oh, and hold it with me
Oh, the dark comes down
We can't sleep
Hold the horizon, hold the horizon
Hold it with me, hold it with me
You're never lost, just learning to breathe
Hold the horizon, hold it with me
Transcription by CastingWords
